prompt:
The image shows one visible 7 by 7 Go board with a highlighted connected stone group and many surrounding black and white stones. Answer the question using the visible board state. The blue outlined black stones are the marked group. Stones of the same color that touch edge to edge form one group. A liberty is an empty intersection directly above, below, left, or right of any stone in the group, and diagonal intersections do not count. Count the liberties of the marked black group. Answer with an integer.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence: set "evidence" to an array of bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] for every empty intersection that is a liberty of the marked black group.
Answer: set "answer" to the number of liberties of the marked black group.
Example JSON:
{"evidence": [[312, 284, 374, 346], [386, 358, 448, 420]], "answer": 4}
